trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: All production regions were rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had a prior healthy production release.
3. **Verified**: Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy across all regions with an error rate of 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged. Root cause of the v2.3.1 regression remains under investigation.
